Anathema.text: On your turn: Until the start of your next turn, other players' Offers go on the Altar face up.
Anathema.why: Blocking Offers stops whole Choirs from scoring under 'no offering, no harvest' (V45: 1.88); now it exposes them instead

Temptation.text: On your turn: Choose a card in another player's Choir. It counts as the opposite alignment this Day.
Temptation.why: Giving a card always helps its receiver once every card scores (V45: 0.62); now a rival's card is turned against them

Mercy.text: At the end of the Day: If you Offered this Day and your Choir scored nothing, gain 1 Glory.
Mercy.why: It must not pay for skipping the Offer (V45: 1.57)

Moloch.text: On your turn: You may discard 1 other Host card from your Choir to gain 3 Glory. Its ability must not have been used this turn.
Moloch.why: A Choir card is worth more now (V45: 0.68 at 2)

Ordeal.text: On your turn: You may invoke this card, then discard it. At this Reaping, your Choir scores double.
